stated_assumptions.description: Saturable process with Michaelis–Menten kinetics dictates reabsorption from the filtrate compartment to the central compartment.
stated_assumptions.evidence_quote: a saturable process with a Michaelis–Menten kinetics dictates reabsorption from the filtrate compartment to the central compartment ( Fig. 1 )

stated_assumptions.description: Oral bioavailability fixed to 90% for both PFOS and PFOA.
stated_assumptions.evidence_quote: The bioavailability was initially set at 90% for both compounds to reflect a high fraction of an administered dose reaching systemic circulation after oral ingestion

stated_assumptions.description: Model does not include a development compartment, thus underestimates serum levels in children and young adults by excluding gestation and breastfeeding exposures.
stated_assumptions.evidence_quote: Data for individuals <20 years of age were excluded from the fitting process because the TK model does not include a development compartment and thus underestimates serum levels in children and young adults by excluding gestation and breastfeeding exposures.

stated_assumptions.description: Parameters for Free, ka, k12, k21 were assigned set values from iterative evaluation of starting parameters.
stated_assumptions.evidence_quote: the proportion of free compound in the serum ( Free ), the rate of absorption from the gut ( k a ), and the rate to and from the second compartment ( k 12 , k 21 ) were assigned set values from the iterative evaluation of the starting parameters ( Table S1 )
stated_assumptions.source_location: Model parameters estimated for humans for both PFOA and PFOS

stated_assumptions.description: The animal models were scaled to humans by adjusting the cardiac blood output ( QCC ) to 12.5 L/h/kg 0.74 and fitting a saturable resorption rate ( Tmc ) for a half-life of 3.4 years and 2.7 years for PFOS and PFOA, respectively.
stated_assumptions.evidence_quote: The animal models were scaled to humans by adjusting the cardiac blood output ( QCC ) to 12.5 L/h/kg 0.74 and fitting a saturable resorption rate ( Tmc ) for a half-life of 3.4 years and 2.7 years for PFOS and PFOA, respectively.

stated_assumptions.description: The remaining parameters were held constant between the animal and human models, as shown in Table 1, with the exception of the PFOA bioAv and K t parameters, which were refit to the nonhuman primate data assuming a bioavailability of 90% for application in the human model, as the lower bioavailability observed in the nonhuman primate model was assumed to be the result of experiment-specific conditions.
